note: Draft mocks, not yet signed off by the owner. Each image is one issue’s card: light and dark, at 1440 and 390 px.

items.title: Chapter regions and render prep where the chapter is finished
items.whatChanges: A DAW tools button in the Editing and Proof headers, and in Master’s “no files yet” state, opens Create chapter regions and Prepare chapter render. Today they exist only in the Engine panel, two clicks away from where a chapter is finished.

items.title: Repair tools beside the defect
items.whatChanges: Repair Pops/Clicks and Magnolius DeClick get a Repair in REAPER button next to Apply in Editing’s Clean up tab and in Proof’s inspector for click, breath and plosive notes. They act on the item selected in REAPER, which Show in REAPER has just selected.

items.title: Compare the recording with the script on the Proof page
items.whatChanges: The comparison, preview and native takes are reachable only through the Engine panel today. They move under the Recording check on the Proof page, next to Check recordings.

items.title: One DAW connection state on every page that needs the DAW
items.whatChanges: The same “REAPER is not connected” chip and dialog on Proof, Pickups and Master, and a working Link project file button on Editing and Production, where the dialog now only says to link the file first.

items.title: Both package builds on Delivery
items.whatChanges: The multi-platform package build moves from Master & QC (before any file is measured) to Delivery, beside the single-profile build. Master keeps measuring, mastering and encoding.

items.whatChanges: Delivery lists each chapter’s result but can only re-read it. A Check files button starts the measurement from the page that blocks the build.

items.whatChanges: Four differently worded “go to the spot in the DAW” controls become one icon button with one label. Pickups rows, which had none, gain it.

items.whatChanges: Match levels is reachable today only from Production’s row menu and the Engine panel. It joins the other clean-up actions in Editing’s drawer, with the same preview and Apply.

items.whatChanges: Writing chapter markers into the finished book MP3 never touches REAPER, so it moves from the REAPER tools card to Delivery’s Output panel, for any DAW or none.

items.whatChanges: Choosing which lane plays is the same decision the takes list already makes, so lane rows with a Play this lane button appear under the line’s takes and the separate dialog goes away.
